title: Single-cell RNA-seq of breast cancer infiltrating T cells
author: Ye, Chengzhong
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Generate single‑cell suspensions
steps.instruction: Prepare single‑cell suspensions from two individual TNBC primary tumor samples (case 2).

steps.title: FACS‑sort CD3⁺ T cells
steps.instruction: FACS‑sort the viable cells for CD3⁺ T cells.

steps.title: Count and assess viability
steps.instruction: Count the sorted cells and assess their viability.

steps.title: Load cells onto Chromium chip
steps.instruction: Load the cell suspension onto a 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell Chip together with the reverse‑transcription (RT) mastermix and single‑cell 3’ gel beads, following the 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell v2 reagent kit protocol.

steps.title: Generate GEMs and reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Generate single‑cell gel‑bead‑in‑emulsions (GEMs) and perform reverse transcription using a Bio‑Rad C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler equipped with a Deep Well Reaction Module.

steps.title: Purify amplified cDNA
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified cDNA using SPRIselect beads (Beckman Coulter, Lane Cove, NSW, Australia).

steps.title: Shear cDNA to ~200 bp
steps.instruction: Shear the purified cDNA to an average fragment size of ~200 bp on a Covaris S2 instrument (Covaris, Woburn, MA, USA) using the manufacturer’s recommended parameters.

steps.title: Generate indexed sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the sheared cDNA, adding a unique sample index (SI) to each library.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on Illumina HiSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the indexed libraries on an Illumina HiSeq 2500 in High Output Mode using V4 clustering and sequencing chemistry.
